prompt.text:
Implement a text-scanning utility in `solution.rs`.

Expose this exact API:

```rust
pub fn first_content_line(text: &str) -> Option<&str>;
```

Return the first line containing at least one non-whitespace Unicode character. Skip leading empty or whitespace-only lines. The returned slice must preserve all leading and trailing whitespace belonging to the selected line, but exclude its line terminator. Support `\n` and `\r\n`; a `\r` immediately before `\n` is part of the terminator and must not be returned. An isolated `\r` is ordinary line content and counts as whitespace.

Empty input and input containing only whitespace return `None`. A final non-empty line without a terminator is valid. The function must borrow from its input, perform no mutation, and use only the standard library. Do not include a `main` function.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
